candidates.label: Theological causality: good comes from Allah while evil comes from oneself establishing asymmetric divine-human attribution
candidates.definition: In 4:78-79: Wherever you are death overtakes you even in fortified towers. If good comes they say this is from Allah; if evil they say this is from you. Say all is from Allah. What comes of good is from Allah; what comes of evil is from yourself.

evidence.excerpt: أَيۡنَمَا تَكُونُواْ يُدۡرِككُّمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ وَلَوۡ كُنتُمۡ فِي بُرُوجٖ مُّشَيَّدَةٖۗ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ حَسَنَةٞ يَقُولُواْ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٞ يَقُولُواْ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنۡ عِندِكَۚ قُلۡ كُلّٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَمَالِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ حَدِيثٗا
evidence.rationale: Qul kullun min AAindi Allahi: universal attribution correcting selective attribution bias. Corrects those who credit good to Allah but blame evil on Prophet.

evidence.excerpt: مَّآ أَصَابَكَ مِنۡ حَسَنَةٖ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَآ أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٖ فَمِن نَّفۡسِكَۚ وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولٗاۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدٗا
evidence.rationale: Ma asabaka min hasanatin famina Allahi wama asabaka min sayyiatin famin nafsika: refined asymmetric formula. Good traced to divine source; evil traced to human agency.

candidates.urduLabel: السببية العقدية: الخير من الله والشر من النفس
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes nuanced theological causality avoiding both absolute determinism and absolute human autonomy. Asymmetry prevents blaming Allah for evil while preserving divine sovereignty over good. Verse 4:78 corrects popular misconception; 4:79 provides precise formulation.

candidates.label: Quranic coherence argument: absence of internal contradiction offered as evidence of divine authorship
candidates.definition: In 4:82: Then do they not reflect upon the Quran? If it had been from other than Allah they would have found within it much contradiction.

evidence.excerpt: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَۚ وَلَوۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ غَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ لَوَجَدُواْ فِيهِ ٱخۡتِلَٰفٗا كَثِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana: rhetorical invitation to deep reflection. Walaw kana min AAindi ghayri Allahi lawajadoo feehi ikhtilafan katheeran: counterfactual argument from textual coherence. Ikhtilafan katheeran (much contradiction) implies human texts inevitably contain inconsistencies.

candidates.urduLabel: تماسك القرآن: عدم التناقض دليل على المنشأ الإلهي
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Unique epistemological argument for Quranic divine origin based on internal consistency rather than external miracle claims. Yatadabbaroona (deep reflection) frames as accessible intellectual exercise. Counterfactual structure makes falsifiable claim.

candidates.label: Intercession moral economy: mediating good earns reward share while mediating evil incurs burden share with Allah as Keeper
candidates.definition: In 4:85: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a share of it; whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a burden of it. And ever is Allah over all things a Keeper.

evidence.excerpt: مَّن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٞ مِّنۡهَاۖ وَمَن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةٗ سَيِّئَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفۡلٞ مِّنۡهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّقِيتٗا
evidence.rationale: Man yashfaAA shafaAAatan hasanatan yakun lahu naseebun minha: positive intercession earns proportional share. Waman yashfaAA shafaAAatan sayyiatan yakun lahu kiflun minha: negative intercession earns proportional burden. Kana Allahu AAala kulli shayin muqeetan: divine oversight guarantees accounting.

candidates.urduLabel: اقتصاد الشفاعة: الوساطة الحسنة تكسب نصيبا والسيئة تكسب كفلا
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes moral accountability for social influence and mediation. Symmetric structure: same mechanism produces reward or burden based on moral quality. Muqeet (Keeper) ensures no intercession escapes divine accounting. Applies broadly beyond formal intercession to all social influence.

candidates.label: Accidental homicide of believer: graduated expiation requiring manumission blood money or fasting based on political relations
candidates.definition: In 4:92: Never for believer to kill believer except by mistake. Whoever kills believer by mistake must free believing slave and pay blood money to family unless forgiven. If from hostile believing people free slave only. If from treaty people blood money plus free slave. If unable fast two consecutive months as repentance from Allah.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤۡمِنٍ أَن يَقۡتُلَ مُؤۡمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَـٔٗاۚ وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤۡمِنًا خَطَـٔٗا فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مُّؤۡمِنَةٖ وَدِيَةٞ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَصَّدَّقُواْۚ فَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوۡمٍ عَدُوّٖ لَّكُمۡ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مُّؤۡمِنَةٖۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوۡمِۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٞ فَدِيَةٞ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ وَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مُّؤۡمِنَةٖۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ شَهۡرَيۡنِ مُتَتَابِعَيۡنِ تَوۡبَةٗ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Wama kana limuminin an yaqtula muminan illa khataan: categorical prohibition with sole exception. Fatahreeru raqabatin muminatin wadiyatun musallamatun: dual obligation. Three scenarios distinguished by victim's political affiliation. Fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabiAAayni tawbatan mina Allahi: fasting as alternative framed as repentance.

candidates.urduLabel: قتل الخطأ: تدرج الكفارة حسب العلاقات السياسية
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Most detailed Quranic homicide legislation. Three-tier system based on victim's community status. Manumission prioritized suggesting abolitionist trajectory. Blood money (diyah) acknowledges collective responsibility. Two-month consecutive fasting as spiritual rehabilitation. Tawbatan mina Allahi frames expiation as divine acceptance pathway.

candidates.label: Verification command (tabayyanoo): mandatory investigation before acting in warfare preventing wrongful targeting of those offering peace
candidates.definition: In 4:94: O believers when you go forth in Allah's way investigate carefully and do not say to one who offers peace 'you are not a believer' aspiring for worldly goods. With Allah are many acquisitions. You were like that before then Allah favored you so investigate.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا ضَرَبۡتُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَبَيَّنُواْ وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلسَّلَٰمَ لَسۡتَ مُؤۡمِنٗا تَبۡتَغُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَغَانِمُ كَثِيرَةٞۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كُنتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Fatabayyanoo: imperative doubled for emphasis. Wala taqooloo liman alqa ilaykumu alssalama lasta muminan: specific prohibition against declaring non-belief based on convenience. Tabtaghoona AAarada alhayati alddunya: identifies material motive for wrongful targeting. Kathalika kuntum min qablu: historical empathy argument.

candidates.urduLabel: التبين: وجوب التحقق قبل العمل في الحرب
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes evidentiary standard for wartime decisions. Doubled tabayyanoo emphasizes thoroughness. Prohibition targets economic exploitation disguised as religious zeal. Historical reminder creates empathetic basis for restraint. Maghanimu katheeratun redirects aspiration toward legitimate divine provision.

candidates.label: Mujahideen preference: active striving with wealth and selves ranked above sitting believers by degrees though both promised good
candidates.definition: In 4:95-96: Not equal are sitting believers other than disabled and mujahideen in Allah's way with wealth and selves. Allah preferred mujahideen by degree. Both promised best. Allah further preferred mujahideen with great reward: degrees from Him forgiveness and mercy.

evidence.excerpt: لَّا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡقَٰعِدُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ غَيۡرُ أُوْلِي ٱلضَّرَرِ وَٱلۡمُجَٰهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡۚ فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡقَٰعِدِينَ دَرَجَةٗۚ وَكُلّٗا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَفَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡقَٰعِدِينَ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: La yastawee alqaAAidoona... waalmujahidoona: explicit inequality statement. Ghayru olee alddarari: disability exemption prevents ableism. Faddala Allahu almujahideena... darajatan: divine preference by degree. Wakullan waAAada Allaha alhusna: baseline reward for both.

evidence.excerpt: دَرَجَٰتٖ مِّنۡهُ وَمَغۡفِرَةٗ وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمًا
evidence.rationale: Darajatin minhu wamaghfiratan warahmatan: triple specification of additional reward.

candidates.urduLabel: تفضيل المجاهدين: الجهاد بالمال والنفس أعلى درجة
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes merit-based hierarchy within faith community. Disability exemption (ghayru olee alddarari) crucial qualifier preventing exclusion. Both groups promised husna (best) maintaining dignity. Additional reward specified as degrees plus forgiveness plus mercy. Financial and physical sacrifice both required for highest rank.

candidates.label: Musta'dafun exemption: genuinely oppressed men women children unable to devise plan or find way excused from emigration obligation
candidates.definition: In 4:98-99: Except the oppressed among men women and children who cannot devise a plan nor find a way. For those perhaps Allah will pardon them. Allah is ever Pardoning Forgiving.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَّا ٱلۡمُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنِ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةٗ وَلَا يَهۡتَدُونَ سَبِيلٗا
evidence.rationale: Illa almustadAAafeena mina alrrijali waalnnisai waalwildani: three demographic categories explicitly named. La yastateeAAoona heelatan wala yahtadoona sabeelan: dual incapacity criterion - no strategy AND no guidance/path.

evidence.excerpt: فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَعۡفُوَ عَنۡهُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَفُوًّا غَفُورٗا
evidence.rationale: Faolaika AAasa Allahu an yaAAfuwa AAanhum: hopeful expectation of pardon. Wakana Allahu AAafuwwan ghafooran: double divine name emphasizing pardoning nature.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Distinguishes genuine mustad'afun from hypocrites claiming oppression in 4:97

candidates.urduLabel: إعفاء المستضعفين: العجز الحقيقي يعفي من الهجرة
candidates.notes: Overlap with hypocrisy (scholarly) via contrast: 4:97 condemns false oppression claims while 4:98-99 exempts genuine incapacity. Gender-inclusive language (men women children) unprecedented in exemption clauses. Dual criterion prevents abuse: must lack both capacity to plan AND access to guidance. AAasa (perhaps/hopefully) expresses divine mercy without guarantee.

candidates.label: Fear-prayer (salat al-khawf): detailed protocol preserving communal worship under military threat with rotating armed parties
candidates.definition: In 4:101-103: When traveling no blame for shortening prayer if fearing disbelievers. When among them leading prayer let party stand with you carrying arms; when prostrated let other party come behind. If rain or ill lay down arms but take precaution. When finished remember Allah standing sitting lying. When secure establish prayer; prayer is timed decree upon believers.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا ضَرَبۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقۡصُرُواْ مِنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنۡ خِفۡتُمۡ أَن يَفۡتِنَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ كَانُواْ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا مُّبِينٗا
evidence.rationale: Falaysa AAalaykum junahun an taqsuroo mina alssalati: concession framed as removal of blame. In khiftum an yaftinakumu allatheena kafaroo: fear condition specified.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا كُنتَ فِيهِمۡ فَأَقَمۡتَ لَهُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَلۡتَقُمۡ طَآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُم مَّعَكَ وَلۡيَأۡخُذُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَهُمۡۖ فَإِذَا سَجَدُواْ فَلۡيَكُونُواْ مِن وَرَآئِكُمۡ وَلۡتَأۡتِ طَآئِفَةٌ أُخۡرَىٰ لَمۡ يُصَلُّواْ فَلۡيُصَلُّواْ مَعَكَ وَلۡيَأۡخُذُواْ حِذۡرَهُمۡ وَأَسۡلِحَتَهُمۡۗ وَدَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ تَغۡفُلُونَ عَنۡ أَسۡلِحَتِكُمۡ وَأَمۡتِعَتِكُمۡ فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيۡكُم مَّيۡلَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِن كَانَ بِكُمۡ أَذٗى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوۡ كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَكُمۡۖ وَخُذُواْ حِذۡرَكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
evidence.rationale: Faltaqum taifatun minhum maAAaka walyakhuthoo aslihatahum: detailed rotation protocol. Wakhuthoo hithrakum: precaution maintained even during concessions.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمٗا وَقُعُودٗا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمۡۚ فَإِذَا ٱطۡمَأۡنَنتُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۚ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ كَانَتۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ كِتَٰبٗا مَّوۡقُوتٗا
evidence.rationale: Inna alssalata kanat AAala almumineena kitaban mawqootan: prayer as fixed temporal obligation underlying all concessions.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Specific wartime adaptation of general prayer obligation

candidates.urduLabel: صلاة الخوف: بروتوكول الصلاة تحت التهديد العسكري
candidates.notes: Overlap with prayer (curated) as specialized application. Most detailed Quranic liturgical protocol. Rotation system balances worship and defense simultaneously. Rain/illness concessions show layered flexibility. Kitaban mawqootan establishes prayer as non-negotiable temporal structure even amid warfare. Post-prayer dhikr in all positions extends worship beyond ritual form.

candidates.label: Opposition to Messenger after guidance: following other than believers' path leads to Hellfire as wretched destination
candidates.definition: In 4:115: And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers We will give him what he has taken and drive him into Hell and evil it is as a destination.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعۡ غَيۡرَ سَبِيلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِۦ مَا تَوَلَّىٰ وَنُصۡلِهِۦ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرًا
evidence.rationale: Waman yushaqiqi alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahu alhuda: opposition defined temporally after clarity. WayattabiAA ghayra sabeeli almumineena: deviation from communal path. Nuwallihi ma tawalla: poetic justice - given what he chose. Wanuslihi jahannama wasaat maseeran: Hellfire as final destination.

candidates.urduLabel: مخالفة الرسول بعد الهدى: اتباع غير سبيل المؤمنين يؤول إلى جهنم
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes two conditions for severe eschatological consequence: opposing Messenger AND following non-believer path. Min ba'di ma tabayyana (after guidance became clear) removes ignorance excuse. Sabeel al-mu'mineen defines orthopraxy communally not just individually. Nuwallihi ma tawalla represents divine irony - granted exactly what was wrongly chosen.

candidates.label: Private conversation ethics: most secret talk has no good except enjoining charity kindness or reconciliation between people
candidates.definition: In 4:114: No good in much of their private conversation except one who enjoins charity or kindness or reconciliation between people. Whoever does that seeking Allah's pleasure We will give great reward.

evidence.excerpt: ۞لَّا خَيۡرَ فِي كَثِيرٖ مِّن نَّجۡوَىٰهُمۡ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَمَرَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَوۡ مَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ إِصۡلَٰحِۭ بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ مَرۡضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ فَسَوۡفَ نُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: La khayra fee katheerin min najwahum: sweeping negative assessment of most private talk. Illa man amara bisadaqatin aw maAAroofin aw islahin bayna alnnasi: three positive exceptions - charity (sadaqah), recognized good (ma'ruf), interpersonal reconciliation (islah). Waman yafAAal thalika ibtighaa mardati Allahi: intention requirement - seeking divine pleasure.

candidates.urduLabel: آداب النجوى: لا خير في كثير من النجوى إلا صدقة أو معروف أو إصلاح
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Elevates social reform activities above idle private discourse. Three categories cover economic (sadaqah), general ethical (ma'ruf), and relational (islah) dimensions. Ibtighaa mardati Allahi establishes intentionality criterion. Ajran AAatheeman (great reward) signals high valuation. Contrasts sharply with condemned najwa of plotters in 4:81,108.
